title: A Few More Tokens Ahead: Reinforcing Parallelism in Diffusion LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.18200v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Parallel generation is widely regarded as an inherent advantage of diffusion large language models. Yet our fixed-quota evaluation of four representative models reveals severe degradation across mathematics and code, with all scores below 15% at 16 tokens per step. Token-level probes identify local predictive potential near the observed prefix, especially in mathematical text. We propose RePara, which reinforces short consecutive token blocks through group-relative policy optimization and reduces rollout and log-probability recomputation costs. On LLaDA and SDAR, \ours improves GSM8K and MATH-500 accuracy over JustGRPO under reduced denoising budgets, with a 1.96x training-step speedup in our LLaDA/MATH setup.

translated_title: 领先几个词元：强化扩散大语言模型中的并行生成能力
translated_abstract: 并行生成被广泛认为是扩散大语言模型的固有优势。然而，我们对四个代表性模型进行的固定配额评估显示，在数学和代码任务上性能严重下降，在每步生成16个词元的设置下，所有分数均低于15%。词元级探测发现，在已观测前缀附近存在较强的局部预测潜力，尤其在数学文本中表现明显。为此，我们提出了RePara方法，该方法通过组相对策略优化（group-relative policy optimization）强化短连续词元块的生成，并降低了采样生成和对数概率重计算的成本。在LLaDA和SDAR模型上，RePara在更少的去噪预算下，相比JustGRPO提升了GSM8K和MATH-500的准确率，并在LLaDA/MATH设置中实现了1.96倍的训练步数加速。
tldr: 提出RePara方法，通过组相对策略优化强化短连续词元块的并行生成，在降低去噪预算的同时显著提升扩散大语言模型在数学任务上的准确率，并实现1.96倍训练加速。
en_tdlr: RePara reinforces short consecutive token blocks via group-relative policy optimization, improving the math accuracy of diffusion LLMs under reduced denoising budgets while achieving a 1.96x training speedup.
